title: Lectin histochemistry of bone regeneration dynamics in the rabbit mandible following transplantation of natural mineral and organic osteoplastic materials
authors: Chelpanova IV, Lutsyk AD, Yashchenko AM, Paltov YV, Strus KI, Savka II. Wiad Lek. 2025;78(12):2594- 2603. doi: 10.36740/WLek/215798. * collacone®
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss collacone / collafleece (collagen cone and fleece) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Lectins of different carbohydrate specificities can be recommended for monitoring bone tissue regeneration after posttraumatic injuries” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
